text:
Anya M: quick UX check — throwing this here: inline field errors vs top summary for the long 'Create Route' form. also debating required marker density and delete confirmation copy. any quick takes? Samir: inline for single-field mistakes is best imo. summary only when there are lots of errors after submit. accessibility-wise we need a live region or role="alert" so SR users get notified. Kevin L: +1. also we should standardize `aria-invalid` + `aria-describedby`. example: ```
Enter a route name
``` Marta P: flag on destructive flows — current delete modal just says "Delete" and it's ambiguous. propose: strong copy "Delete route permanently" + either typed confirm for bulk or a required checkbox for single items. typed confirm is heavier but safest. Anya M: agree on safety. prefer typed confirm for bulk or production routes, checkbox for quick single deletes. main concern: friction vs safety. Samir: required marker debate: asterisk alone isn't sufficient for accessibility. we should show visible "Required" label or helper text and add `aria-required="true"` on inputs. that covers both sighted and SR users. Kevin L: exact — do not `aria-hidden` the label. visible "Required" + `aria-required` is the pattern. also consider only marking required at group level where sensible to reduce visual clutter. Marta P: copy nit for errors: prefer directive microcopy — e.g., "Enter a name" vs "Name is required". action-first tends to be clearer in testing. Anya M: also focus management: after submit with errors, focus should jump to the first invalid field and the summary (if present) should be keyboard-focusable so users get context. Samir: :thumbsup: will prototype the focus + live region states in Figma. Kevin L: small contrast/accessibility nit — we rely on red borders + icon to signal errors. color-only is fragile; ensure icon + text and check contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text. Marta P: for delete modal copy, draft suggestion: "This will permanently delete the route "". This action cannot be undone. Type the route name to confirm." For single-item deletes: "Click Delete and check "I understand this cannot be undone". Anya M: cool, let's converge on a checklist: 1) Inline errors for field-level; top summary only if >2 errors on submit. 2) Visible "Required" label + `aria-required`. 3) Focus first invalid; summary is focusable and uses `role=alert` or polite live region. 4) Delete modal: typed confirm for bulk/prod, checkbox for single; explicit copy as Marta suggested. 5) No color-only indicators — icon + text. Samir: i'll make two screens (inline-first, summary-after-submit) and include a11y notes. will post before EOD. Kevin L: i'll open a tiny front-end PR with the `aria-invalid`/`aria-describedby` patterns and error region helper. Marta P: i'll prepare two copy variants (concise / explicit) and link them in the doc. aria-bot: accessibility checklist: https://intranet.redwood/a11y/checklist (posted) Anya M: thanks all. if there are no major objections i'll mark this as the pattern we ship for the form iteration. Samir: no objections from me. Kevin L: good to go from engineering side. Marta P: ok, will finalize copy.
